setBoundary: Instances where the user met up with their aunt and received the crystal chandelier

items.why: States the user received the crystal chandelier from their aunt “today” (session dated 2023/03/04), which is the anchor needed to compute how many weeks ago relative to 2023/04/01.
Assistant congratulates the user on the new chandelier acquisition from the aunt, reinforcing that the meeting/acquisition occurred on that same day.
